description: Look at a native template: render it (section cache makes repeat looks fast) and return still frames as PNG images plus their paths. Pick moments with `at` (seconds or time references on the whole video), `atTransitions` and `perSection` (default); tile them with `sheet`, shade a platform UI with `safe`, crop with `zoom`; compare templates with `variants` or every LOOK preset with `looks`. Call it after validate_template to check composition, contrast and safe zones before compose_video.

at.description: Moments to grab, on the whole video: seconds, or "<section>.start|end", "<id>.start|end" (an element id), "50%", "end", "beat:8", "bar:2", "cue:drop", each with an optional "+ 0.2" / "- 0.1".

atTransitions.description: Each section boundary, 0.1 s before and 0.2 s after the cut.

fields.description: Values for global.fields and form fields, by name (validate_template lists them).

format.description: Output format to render (landscape | portrait | square): the template composition for that format (its `formats` override and `$format` values). Default: the template orientation.

looks.description: Tile the section at the first `at` moment once per LOOK preset (the section alone; slow).

perSection.description: Each section once its last kinetic/graphic entrance has landed (+0.2 s). The default plan.

safe.description: Shade a delivery platform UI zones (tiktok, reels, shorts, youtube…) to check text stays clear.

sheet.description: Tile the frames into labelled contact sheets (time + section per tile); returns the sheets as images.

variants.description: Other templates to compare: the first `at` moment of `template` and of each, in one labelled grid.

zoom.description: Crop every frame to x/y/w/h, fractions of the frame (0..1) or pixels.

name: render_frames
title: Render Frames
